svg.text: C 处记下“前面是 B”
C notes that B came before
当前是 B，读取“前面是 B”的位置
current token B reads where B came before
下层的头先把前一个 token 写入每个位置，
A lower head first writes the previous token into each position,
上层的头据此找到上一次出现之后的 token
and a higher head uses it to find what followed last time
GPT-2 small 各头的归纳得分（实测）
Induction score of every head of GPT-2 small (measured)
红框是前一 token 头 L4H11
the red frame marks the previous-token head L4H11
